about_the_game:
JOIN US IN EARLY DEVELOPMENT

Lekano World is still growing - visuals are temporary, and gameplay is evolving with every update. Become part of the journey and witness how the world transforms together with the community.




BETA ACCESS

Access is limited to beta testers.

Click Request Access and be among the first to explore Lekano World and influence its development.





A World Waiting for Its Hero

Welcome to LEKANO WORLD - a mysterious realm torn between past and future, where floating islands hide the secrets of forgotten civilizations, and ancient magic still lives in the hearts of mystical creatures known as Lekamons.

Once a land of prosperity and harmony, this world fell into chaos after the Great Catastrophe. The shards of the legendary crystal that gave life to everything are now scattered across the land, while the Shadows of Oblivion - the Vorlaks - slowly consume what remains of reality.

You are a Lekanit, an awakened one chosen at the brink of despair. Your mission is to restore balance, tame powerful Lekamons, master the ancient force of Léi'tana, and challenge the darkness to save this dying world.

Explore ancient ruins, fight in legendary arenas, uncover the secrets of the floating isles, and become the hero spoken of in legends.

In LEKANO WORLD, every step is a discovery, every battle is a test, and beyond every horizon lies more than meets the eye.

Arena Battles

The arena is the heart of the Lekamon world - where legends are born. Engage in diverse PvP modes, from intense duels to massive 6v6 team battles. Only in the arena can you earn valuable artifacts and in-game rewards. Every fight is a chance to grow stronger and earn your place among the greatest Lekanits.

Lekamons - Unique Beings, Not Just Pets

In LEKANO WORLD, no two Lekamons are the same. Each has a unique appearance, eye color, size, personality, stats, and skill sets.

Catching a Lekamon isn’t a victory - it’s a privilege you have to earn. You don’t just "throw a ball" and get a new friend... you know what I mean...

In LEKANO WORLD, you fight, weaken the Lekamon, revert it to its egg form through magic, and only then, using the power of Léi'tana, reveal the ancient truth - that since the dawn of time, humans and Lekamons have been allies and protectors of each other.

This forgotten knowledge becomes the foundation of your bond.

Only then will it become your companion.

But don’t expect blind loyalty - every Lekamon has its own character. Some will be loyal allies, others stubborn challengers who respect only strength. The hunt for rare forms, unique colors, and perfect skills will keep you coming back for more.




Unique RPG Progression

Forget linear evolutions - you shape your Lekamon’s destiny. Distribute attributes, unlock hidden abilities through trust and battle experience, and craft strategies to match your playstyle.

Here, every player can own a truly powerful Lekamon - not because of rarity, but through skill and smart development.




An Open World That Reacts to You

Floating islands, shattered cities, and ancient ruins - the world of LEKANO WORLD changes based on your decisions. This is your personal reality among thousands of others, filled with secrets, puzzles, and dangers.

The Lekanit Hub remains the only place where players can meet, trade, and prepare for new adventures.




Lekanit Hub

A safe haven near the Great Crystal, where Lekanits gather to trade Lekamons and artifacts, participate in mini-games like the legendary LECAPS, and get ready for battles and raids.




Lekrion and Lekavium - Your World Within a World

With the Lekrion bracelet, you gain access to Lekavium - a personal dimension where you build a home for your Lekamons, train them, and create a space that reflects your journey.




Vorlaks - The Darkness Consuming the World

When night falls, the Vorlaks emerge from the rifts. Hunt these shadows of oblivion for rare resources, but beware - only the strong survive until dawn.




Key Features of LEKANO WORLD:

  • Tactical arena battles with dynamic PvP and raid bosses

  • Deep taming and breeding system for truly unique Lekamons

  • Full freedom to develop custom builds

  • Linénergy system - unlock powerful combo abilities

  • A responsive open world shaped by your actions

  • Personal Lekavium - build your sanctuary

  • Mini-games and in-game economy

  • Fight for the title of Arena Hero




LEKANO WORLD ONLINE is more than a game. It’s your story in a world that needs a hero.
detailed_description:
Roadmap

Q2 2025

  • Closed Beta Test of Arena Battles ("Deathmatch" Mode)

  • Combat system balancing

  • Implementation of reporting and feedback systems

  • Testing new Lekamons with the BETAR group

  • Adding new Lekamons

Q3 2025

  • Creation of islands, biomes, and development of an open world with a dynamic ecosystem

  • Implementation of Lekamon growth and form system (first prototype)

  • Improvement of Lekamon catching mechanics

  • Launch of in-game economy (trading, exchange, auctions)

  • Adding new Lekamons

  • Announcement of Lekavium and Lekanit customization system

Q4 2025

  • Adding new Lekamons

  • New PvP arena modes and start of raid boss development

  • Implementation of events system

  • First seasonal in-game rewards

  • Adding mini-games like Click and Caps

  • Battle Pass system with useful resources and accessories

  • Lekamon balancing

Q1 2026
Early Access Launch

  • Core mechanics: battles, catching, raising, quests, customization

  • World expansion: new biomes and islands

  • Adding new Lekamons

  • Controller support and UI optimization

  • Implementation of anti-cheat and player reputation systems

Long-Term Goals (2026+)

  • Cross-platform version (PC and consoles)

  • Guilds and clan wars

  • Raids and world bosses

  • Seasons with global rankings and rewards

  • Story campaign and scenario-based quests

  • Free-to-Play version with fair cosmetic monetization (no Pay2Win)
